20182.long_desc:
A professional 27.5 inch LCD Monitor designed for all arcade machines with 29inch CRT monitors, offering a 4:3 viewing ratio with VGA and HDMI inputs and supports 15khz/24khz/31khz, and high definition up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution. Highly suitable for candy cabinets such as Blast City. The features of the new 27.5inch LCD arcade monitor are;
  • RGB, VGA & HDMI input
  • video input support: 15khz, 24khz, 31khz, and up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution at low monitor lag
  • custom Arcooda firmware designed specifically for the arcade and amusement industries. Firmware has been designed to be plug and play for as many arcade game boards as possible, including "auto" button to quickly centre your arcade game's picture.
  • extendable monitor adjustment board. Mount inside the monitor frame, or, use the extension to mount at the front of your arcade machine.
  • Audio output support: connect your HDMI input into the Arcooda 27.56 inch arcade LCD monitor, then connect your 3.5mm audio jack out of the monitor into your audio system.
  • full viewing angle, ideal for arcade games.
  • mounting frame now supports VESA (8 x M412) or use the included mounting brackets to add into your arcade machine.
    • The Arcooda arcade monitor firmware has been refined over many years. The 27.5inch LCD 4x3 ratio arcade monitors come with these additional add-on parts for free; - Arcooda RGB to VGA Adapter Board with Colour Correction - Second monitor button settings board - 1.6 metre extension cable for OSD button board
